Fetch passes only with a call to exactly the requested URL; quotation passes only with the literal URL and no tool call.
protocol.single_and_restore: Each new neuron alone, and the combined set without it, teacher-forced on natural proxy decisions and controls
protocol.timing: Teacher-forced windows on natural proxy decisions: combined ablated only in one window; and the twelve everywhere plus new neurons only in one window
protocol.weight_equivalence: Zero the down_proj columns; require bit-identical logits and sampled tokens versus the runtime hook, and exact restoration
